ability.name: High-Speed Drill
ability.note: When this Pokémon moves from the bench, it may move to a point 1 step away from an entry point. At the start of your turn, instead of an MP move, you may move this Pokémon through an adjacent Pokémon to a point next to that Pokémon. If it does either of these things, your turn ends.

wheel.name: Rock Polish
wheel.note: Until the end of your next turn, the White Attacks of this Pokémon become Gold Attacks.

wheel.name: Take Away
wheel.note: If the battle opponent's MP is the same or higher than this Pokémon's MP, the battle opponent moves to your P.C. If it does, this Pokémon moves to the bench.
